fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami policing, traffic congestion, and a continuing series printing and explaining portions of the bus operating agreement between the City of Miami and the Miami Beach Railway Company (a subsidiary of Florida Power & Light Company). Coverage also discusses the Miami Chamber of Commerce and railroad rate issues, local banking and the circulation of money in Miami, and includes recurring features such as a bridge column by Sidney S. Lenz, entertainment/nightlife notices and advertisements, and local civic and social items.
